summary.intent: Run the full GSD ship loop for Phase 62 (Unified Node Codec Core Keystone) autonomously: verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E gate → CodeRabbit CLI → ship (open PR) → resolve reviews → confirm CI green.
summary.outcome: PR #578 opened with all pre-ship gates passing; one real in-scope fix applied (unsealNode envelope guard) plus one CI regression fixed (tsconfig.scripts.json missing exclusion for FilePointer-era E2E helper scripts). CI was still settling at transcript end with Typecheck as the lone failure under active fix.

repo: tsconfig.scripts.json typechecks packages/sdk-core/scripts/*.mts and tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/*.ts in CI — this gate is distinct from the core/sdk/web typecheck and must be included in the local D-02 gate; failing to run it locally masked a real CI regression

FilePointer-era E2E helper scripts (edit-filepointer.mts, verify-filepointer.mts, rename-folder.mts, bump-ipns-sequence.ts) reference retired types and cannot be migrated until phases 63–65 un-stub the read-chain; they must be excluded from tsconfig.scripts.json as a quarantine

sdk-e2e CI job is gated on `if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'` — any source change triggers it; the executors correctly quarantined sdk unit suites per D-02 but missed all 11 tests/sdk-e2e suites, which would have failed on the stubbed client
CodeRabbit on this repo posts findings in the PR review body, not as inline threads — the GraphQL reviewThreads query returns 0 even when findings exist; parse pulls/{N}/reviews[].body instead
CodeRabbit's PR-level auto-review silently fails (posts a 'pass' placeholder) when the diff exceeds ~136 files; the CLI pre-ship review is the only actionable source of findings for large phases
After gh pr create, github-actions[bot] pushes a chore(release) commit — must git fetch + rebase onto it before any subsequent push or the push is rejected
gh pr edit fails on this repo (Projects-classic GraphQL) — patch PR body via `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file`
landing/.astro/ is gitignored and absent on origin — local eslint failures there are not real CI failures; scoped eslint on phase paths is the correct local gate
commit.gpgsign is false in this environment — all commits are unsigned; the 2-minute 'hang' seen during execute-phase was the slow lint-staged pre-commit hook, not a signing timeout
GSD commit helper returns commit_failed while the commit actually lands (known false-negative) — always verify with git log --oneline -1, never retry blindly

code.finding: unsealNode was missing a forward-compat envelope guard on schema/aeadVersion fields — these are plaintext (not AAD-bound) so a v1 reader silently ignored unknown values; added fail-closed guard that throws on unrecognized values, vector-safe (190 tests green)

Added exclude array for the four FilePointer-era E2E helper scripts to quarantine them from the compile gate until phases 63–65 re-wire the read-chain; same D-02 quarantine pattern used for sdk unit suites
All 11 sdk-e2e suite files needed describe.skip quarantine (D-01 non-runnable mid-milestone); executors skipped this during execute-phase, creating a real CI gap caught at ship time

workflow: When running pnpm typecheck locally via `bash -lc 'tsc ...'`, tsc may not be on PATH — this surfaces as exit 127 'command not found' and can mask real type errors that CI catches; use `pnpm exec tsc` or ensure PATH includes node_modules/.bin
CodeRabbit CLI --agent suggestions on large diffs frequently point to changes already implemented; always grep for the distinctive suggestion strings in the current source before applying any fix
Sequential executor on the main worktree is preferable to parallel worktrees for pnpm monorepos: no per-worktree node_modules, simpler cross-package dist chain, lower risk for unsupervised execution

Freeze-first discipline (D-04) for crypto codecs is a reason to defer DRY consolidation across frozen files — consolidating 3 frozen codec files right before ship introduces unnecessary churn on verified code

The real D-02 gate for a compile-only milestone phase must include: builds (production tsc), web tsc -b, core codec tests, lint on phase paths, AND scripts typecheck — easy to accidentally omit the last one

friction: Local pnpm typecheck scripts step reported `tsc: command not found` (PATH issue in bash -lc), which was misdiagnosed as the known TS2688 @types/node local flake — this masked a real CI regression (FilePointer-era .mts scripts) that only surfaced after the PR was opened
CodeRabbit CLI reviewing a 136-file diff took ~8+ minutes; the PR-level auto-review then silently failed due to diff size, making the CLI pass the only usable source of automated findings
GSD commit helper false-negatives required verify-via-git-log after every commit throughout the session

GPG signing environment: commit.gpgsign=false globally, so all phase commits are unsigned — this requires explicit note in the PR and may need attention before merge if the repo enforces signed commits
The sdk-e2e quarantine gap was an executor miss that cost an additional commit and PR iteration; the execute-phase workflow has no post-wave gate that checks tsconfig.scripts.json consumers
